calls.title: Naina Manga-Virtue and Jake Heier
calls.summary: The team confirmed the technical setup for running AA tests with Growth Book and Snowflake, ensuring a 50/50 client ID split for exposure tracking. Adjustments were identified for data source connections, with Ruby committed to fixing misconfigured table names. The decision was made to switch from anonymous client IDs to internal member IDs to improve logged-in user metrics. Additionally, a test metric was defined by Ruby to measure the impact of map-based searches, with filtering for residential property categories. The team agreed to begin with AA tests before transitioning to AB tests, emphasizing the importance of data integrity. Follow-up actions were established to finalize data sources and schedule meetings for progress review.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Snowflake, Experiment Setup, AA Test, Metric Definition, User Bucketing
